title: Aromatic Saudi Arabian Lentil Grill
description: Indulgent Saudi-Arabian dish featuring puy-lentils and bonito-shave, perfect for a special occasion. This macrobiotic-friendly recipe is cooked to perfection on a binchotan-grill.
instructions: Preheat the binchotan-grill to medium-high heat.
In a medium saucepan, bring 2 cups of water to a boil.
Add the puy-lentils to the saucepan, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, cumin, coriander, black pepper, and salt.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the bowl and stir to combine.
Once the lentils are cooked, drain and add them to the bowl, stirring to combine with the onion mixture.
Stir in the bonito-shave and lemon juice.
Using a slotted spoon, transfer the lentil mixture to the preheated binchotan-grill.
Cook for 5-7 minutes per side, or until the lentils are slightly charred.
Serve hot, garnished with additional lemon juice if desired.
